results.title: Podcast hosting pricing: how much does it cost? - Transistor
results.snippet: We don't limit the number of episodes you can upload or the amount of total storage on Transistor. Individual audio files can be up to 1000MB, which in mp3 format is many hours of audio. Our pricing plans are based on the number of monthly downloads you get.

results.title: Transistor.fm Podcast Hosting Review | Details, Pricing, and Features
results.snippet: Transistor offers 3 plans: Starter ($19/mo), Professional ($49/mo), and Business ($99/mo). Every plan allows for an unlimited number of podcasts and episode storage but there is a monthly download limit of 10,000, 50,000, and 150,000 respectively.
